titleText: Enemalta installs six kilometres of new electricity cables in Birkirkara
mainText: From Times of Malta: Enemalta installs six kilometres of new electricity cables in Birkirkara. Project aims to reinforce the network and meet growing electricity demand

titleText: Two hunters fined over illegal bird callers at Mellieħa Natura 2000 site
mainText: From MaltaToday: Two hunters fined over illegal bird callers at Mellieħa Natura 2000 site. Two hunters were fined after police discovered illegally used electronic bird callers at the White Tower Natura 2000 site in Mellieħa, following reports by the Malta Ranger Unit. In a Facebook post, the MRU said the protected site is increasingly becoming a hotspot for illegal hunting.

titleText: €4.7 million Familja+ scheme to support 7,000 children, with up to €700 per child annually
mainText: From The Malta Independent: €4.7 million Familja+ scheme to support 7,000 children, with up to €700 per child annually. Around 7,000 children in vulnerable situations are expected to benefit from a new €4.7 million government scheme offering financial assistance for essential household items, mental well-being services and extracurricular activities.

titleText: Repeat offender caught gambling at casino during curfew
mainText: From Times of Malta: Repeat offender caught gambling at casino during curfew. Adrian Muscat, known as ‘il-Galletta’, granted bail again after admitting to using another person’s ID card to enter casino

titleText: Malta-registered tanker sinks off Ibiza, one crew member dies
mainText: From MaltaToday: Malta-registered tanker sinks off Ibiza, one crew member dies. A Malta-registered tanker sank off the coast of Ibiza, Spain, in the early hours of Thursday 26 November, leaving one crew member dead, Transport Malta has confirmed.
